topic: Spring Boot 3 REST APIs & Modern Architecture

slides.title: Spring Boot 3 REST APIs
bullets: Building production-grade microservices with Java 21
Modern controller patterns and declarative REST client
Rigorous verification and automated test contracts
slides.notes: Welcome participants. State session goals: build REST endpoints, understand validation, and verify everything in isolation.

slides.title: Architecture & Verification Pipeline
bullets: Zero-trust course material: all code is pre-verified
Java 21 virtual threads and Spring Boot 3 foundation
Predictable JSON contracts for slides and live exercises
slides.diagram:
graph LR
  A[Trainer UI] --> B[FastAPI Orchestrator]
  B --> C[Generator]
  C --> D[Sandbox Verifier]
  D --> E[Deck Builder PPTX]
slides.notes: Explain why unverified code harms trainer credibility. Emphasize that every code block in these slides was compiled and run in a real sandbox.

slides.title: A First REST Controller
bullets: Maps HTTP GET requests to endpoint /api/v1/hello
Returns strongly-typed Greeting response record
Runs on Spring Boot 3 with Java 21 records
slides.notes: Highlight Java 21 records replacing boilerplate DTOs. Notice the immutability and clean JSON serialization.

slides.title: Request Validation with Jakarta EE
bullets: Spring Boot 3 uses jakarta.validation namespace
Enforces non-blank names and positive price tags
Automatic 400 Bad Request on validation failure
slides.notes: Remind students of the javax.* to jakarta.* migration that occurred in Spring Boot 3.

slides.title: Virtual Threads & Concurrency
bullets: Java 21 Project Loom virtual threads enabled by default
Configure: spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true
Handles tens of thousands of concurrent I/O operations
slides.diagram:
flowchart TD
  Req[Incoming HTTP Request] --> VT[Lightweight Virtual Thread]
  VT --> DB[(Blocking Database Query)]
  DB -. Unparks .-> Carrier[Carrier OS Thread Freed]
slides.notes: Explain how virtual threads unblock OS threads during blocking socket I/O.

slides.title: Hands-on Exercise: Item Filter Service
bullets: Implement item filtering by threshold price
Run unit tests verifying edge cases and null handling
Proven contract: tests must reject naive solutions
slides.notes: Direct students to exercise e_001. Point out how tests catch missing active status filters.

slides.title: Summary & Key Takeaways
bullets: Spring Boot 3 pairs cleanly with modern Java 21 features
Declarative validation catches bad inputs at the perimeter
All materials backed by sandbox execution proofs
slides.notes: Wrap up session and distribute cheat sheet and lab repository link.

exercises.title: Item Filter & Discount Calculator
exercises.description: Implement filter_and_discount(items, min_price, discount_rate) which retains active items with price >= min_price, applies the discount_rate percentage, and rounds to 2 decimal places.
exercises.tests:
def test_exercise(func):
    data = [
        {'id': 1, 'price': 100.0, 'active': True},
        {'id': 2, 'price': 50.0, 'active': False},
        {'id': 3, 'price': 200.0, 'active': True},
        {'id': 4, 'price': 30.0, 'active': True}
    ]
    # Must filter price >= 50 and active == True
    result = func(data, 50.0, 0.10)
    assert len(result) == 2, f'Expected 2 items, got {len(result)}'
    assert result[0]['id'] == 1 and result[0]['discounted_price'] == 90.0
    assert result[1]['id'] == 3 and result[1]['discounted_price'] == 180.0
    # Inactive item id=2 must be excluded
    ids = [i['id'] for i in result]
    assert 2 not in ids, 'Inactive items must be filtered out'
    return True

quiz.question: Which package namespace replaces javax.* in Spring Boot 3 / Spring Framework 6?
quiz.explanation: Spring Boot 3 migrated all Java EE dependencies to Jakarta EE 10, replacing javax.* packages with jakarta.*.

quiz.question: How are Virtual Threads enabled in application.properties in Spring Boot 3.2+?
quiz.explanation: Setting spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true instructs the embedded Tomcat container and task executors to use Virtual Threads.
